manifest.description: Browse and read files on the machine running Kiro Crew without leaving the dashboard. Keep several files open in tabs, walk the directory tree with each file's git status shown beside it, search a whole folder for a string, and read markdown rendered rather than raw. It is read-only by design: it opens and searches files but never edits, moves, or deletes them, and it can only reach your home directory, the system temp directory, and on Linux and macOS the /home, /opt, and /workplace trees.
manifest.highlight_1: Read-only: opens and searches files, and never writes, moves, or deletes them
manifest.highlight_2: Multiple files open at once in tabs, with syntax highlighting
manifest.highlight_3: Markdown files render as formatted text instead of raw source
manifest.highlight_4: Directory tree shows each file's git status inline
manifest.highlight_5: Search across a directory with line-level matches and surrounding preview
manifest.highlight_6: Reachable paths are your home directory, the system temp directory, and on Linux and macOS /home /opt, and /workplace — symlinks out are refused
manifest.use_case_1: Read, search, preview, download, or discuss files on the gateway host without granting the page write access.
manifest.configuration_1: Enable the app and open an allowed directory from the path bar; no account is required, and git or ripgrep only add optional status and search enhancements.
